contexts.text: Some Spirits retain these things; some do not.
They retain this from their life (here).
The Angels retain no idea of any person...
Those in the World of Spirits... especially the evil, at first retain the things they had (here)...

In the interior memory are retained all things. They who are in falsity... and evil, retain all things which agree therewith... Other things enter, but are so slightly retained... Whereas they who are in truth... and good, retain all things true and good...
A (regenerate) man retains the inclination to evil, and evil itself; but is withheld from evil...
He (there) retains nothing from the historicals of the Word.
(The Knowledges) they have once acquired they retain... Thus (Spirits) retain what they hear, see, and apperceive, most especially such things as they are delighted with. SE 3234. SE 3258. SE 3259.
The Spirits could not restrain themselves from leading the infants to speak.
(Otherwise) these things... can be understood, but not retained...
After they had heard these arcana and perceived them... they retained nothing.
If (the man) is in any affection of knowing, he understands these things, and also retains them.
Hold fast what thou hast () = that meanwhile they should remain steadily in their truths and good. AE 173. AE 217.
Holding back the four winds of the earth... () = a stronger influx... which is kept back by the Lord. AE 304:58. AE 418.
The holding back of the influx. Signified.
Every devil can understand truth when he hears it, but cannot retain it. Explained. CL 415:3. TCR 77:3.
How can man receive anything of love and wisdom, and retain it... unless he feels it as his own?
Still, he retains the faculty of elevating the understanding. The reason he retains it, is...
I could no longer restrain my laughter.
His memory retains every particular...
They who have accustomed themselves to speak filthy things, (there) retain like things.
They want to retain him, and strive with all their might to retain him.
He was detained a moment... He perceived that if he had not been detained...
He took away all understanding... I could not retain the least item.
The man feels... a kind of holding back.
